Manifest.Name: Type Demand & Risk Stars
Manifest.Author: WRT fork; based on KCN-judu
Manifest.Description: Demand outlines colored by item type, with one container-hint color. Independent permanent pixel stars on all item views: yellow stolen, green contraband, red both. Colors, thickness, rounding, fill and star size are configurable in the native Mods settings panel. Disable the original Demand Highlight when using this fork.
